name: Amazon S3
label: Amazon S3 REST API (2006-03-01)
description: Amazon S3 REST API (2006-03-01). Official API https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/Welcome.html. Path-style URLs https://s3.{region}.amazonaws.com/{bucket}/{key} signed with AWS SigV4 (service s3). One node; pick operation. Upload/download use type file (platform file ref-id). Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. Folders are prefix+delimiter conventions. listen maps to PutBucketNotificationConfiguration plus BPMN message events — S3 cannot long-poll. IAM least-privilege; customer owns bucket policy. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port. File bytes are type file.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: bucket_create, bucket_delete, bucket_list, bucket_search, file_copy, file_delete, file_download, file_list, file_upload, folder_create, folder_delete, folder_list, listen.

schema.label: from_path
schema.description: x-amz-copy-source for file_copy: /sourceBucket/sourceKey (URL-encoded). Required for file_copy. Example: /invoices-prod/old.pdf.

schema.label: bucket
schema.description: S3 bucket name (path /{bucket}). Used by every object/bucket op except bucket_list. Example: invoices-prod.

schema.label: key
schema.description: Object key (path /{bucket}/{key}) for file_upload/download/delete/copy and folder_*. Example: reports/2026.pdf.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Object bytes for file_upload (PUT /{bucket}/{key}). Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes. Required for file_upload.

schema.label: list-type
schema.description: ListObjectsV2 query list-type. Send 2. Used by bucket_search, file_list, folder_list. Example: 2.

schema.label: prefix
schema.description: Key prefix filter for bucket_search, file_list, folder_list. Example: reports/.

schema.label: start-after
schema.description: ListObjectsV2 start-after key for bucket_search. Example: reports/2025.pdf.

schema.label: max-keys
schema.description: Max keys to return (1–1000) for bucket_search and file_list. Example: 100.

schema.label: versionId
schema.description: Object versionId query for file_delete. Example: 3/L4kqtJl40Nr8X8gdRQBpUMLUo.

schema.label: delimiter
schema.description: Delimiter for file_list / folder_list (usually /). Example: /.

schema.label: continuation-token
schema.description: ListObjectsV2 continuation-token from a previous file_list response.

schema.label: acl
schema.description: x-amz-acl on file_upload. EXACT: private | public-read | public-read-write | authenticated-read | aws-exec-read | bucket-owner-read | bucket-owner-full-control. Example: private.

schema.label: storage_class
schema.description: x-amz-storage-class on file_upload. EXACT: STANDARD | REDUCED_REDUNDANCY | STANDARD_IA | ONEZONE_IA | INTELLIGENT_TIERING | GLACIER | DEEP_ARCHIVE | GLACIER_IR. Example: STANDARD.

schema.label: server_side_encryption
schema.description: x-amz-server-side-encryption on file_upload. EXACT: AES256 | aws:kms | aws:kms:dsse. Example: AES256.

schema.label: tagging
schema.description: x-amz-tagging on file_upload: URL-encoded key=value pairs. Example: project=alpha&env=prod.

schema.label: cache_control
schema.description: Cache-Control header on file_upload. Example: max-age=3600.

schema.label: content_disposition
schema.description: Content-Disposition header on file_upload. Example: attachment; filename="report.pdf".

schema.label: content_encoding
schema.description: Content-Encoding header on file_upload. Example: gzip.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on success.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body or text.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Secret Access Key
configurationParameters.description: AWS secret access key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Session Token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token (x-amz-security-token). Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Access Key Id
configurationParameters.description: AWS access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: Signing and path-style endpoint region (us-east-1, …). Host is s3.{region}.amazonaws.com.

configurationParameters.label: File
configurationParameters.description: Default upload/convert/sign source. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: bucket
configurationParameters.description: Default S3 bucket when INPUT bucket is empty. Example: invoices-prod.
